name: Deck The Halls
summary: Welcome to Deck The Halls. Deck The Halls is a x-mas themed game with a lot of maps to play in with your friends. If you love snow this is the game for you, in Deck The Halls it is snowing year round. If you are big on safety this is a good pic because we have a lot of mods, admins and owners making sure the game is safe all the time.
